info.title: Business Settings API
info.description: Endpoints for reading and updating a business's own profile settings (name, address, phone, website, and client-facing visibility flags). The business address is stored as a free-text string and geocoded server-side into a read-only `structured_address`. Available for **Staff & Directory tokens** — a Staff token of a staff member belonging to the business (with settings access), or a Directory token of the owning directory. Directory tokens MUST send the business in the `X-On-Behalf-Of` header; a Directory token without it is rejected with 403.

get.description:
## Overview
Returns the full settings object for the business, including profile fields, client-facing visibility flags, branding, and the server-geocoded `structured_address`.

Available for **Staff & Directory tokens** — a Staff token of a staff member belonging to the business, or a Directory token of the owning directory. Directory tokens MUST send the business in the `X-On-Behalf-Of` header (a Directory token without it is rejected with 403).

parameters.description: The business UID — the public identifier of the business (e.g., "fyclhomrzdspdyk6").
parameters.name: business_uid

parameters.description: The business UID to act on behalf of. Required when authenticating with a Directory token; not needed for a Staff token (e.g., "fyclhomrzdspdyk6").
parameters.name: X-On-Behalf-Of

application/json.name: Summit Peak Climate Solutions
application/json.address: 233 S Wacker Dr, Chicago, IL 60606, USA

structured_address.formatted_address: 233 S Wacker Dr, Chicago, IL 60606, USA

application/json.invoice_terms: Payment of invoices is due by the due date specified, or may be subject to late payment fees or interest charges.
application/json.estimate_terms: The estimate covers listed services/items only, and is based on the information provided at the time. Changes or additions may increase costs. The estimate is valid only until the expiration date specified, unless updated otherwise.

put.description:
## Overview
Updates the business's own profile settings. Only the fields provided in the body are changed.

The **`address`** is a plain free-text string; it is geocoded server-side into `structured_address`, so a real, resolvable address must be sent (a made-up string may fail to geocode). `structured_address` is **read-only** and cannot be supplied as input — it is returned on the response once geocoding completes.

Available for **Staff & Directory tokens** — a Staff token of a staff member belonging to the business (with settings access), or a Directory token of the owning directory. Directory tokens MUST send the business in the `X-On-Behalf-Of` header (without it, a Directory token is rejected with 403). A client token or an unrelated staff is rejected with 401/403.

parameters.description: The business UID — the public identifier of the business (e.g., "fyclhomrzdspdyk6").
parameters.name: business_uid

parameters.description: The business UID to act on behalf of. Required when authenticating with a Directory token; not needed for a Staff token (e.g., "fyclhomrzdspdyk6").
parameters.name: X-On-Behalf-Of

parameters.description: The settings fields to update. All fields are optional; send only the ones you want to change.
parameters.name: body

name.description: Display name of the business (e.g., "Summit Peak Climate Solutions").

address.description: The business's physical street address as free text. Geocoded server-side into the read-only `structured_address`; send a real, resolvable address (e.g., "233 S Wacker Dr, Chicago, IL 60606, USA").

billing_address.description: The billing address as free text, used on invoices and estimates (e.g., "233 S Wacker Dr, Chicago, IL 60606, USA").

business_description.description: Short description of the business shown to clients (e.g., "Residential and commercial HVAC service.").

country_name.description: Country name for the business (e.g., "United States").

display_country_code.description: Whether to show the country dialing code alongside the phone number (e.g., true, false).

sender_name.description: The name used as the sender on outgoing client communications (e.g., "Summit Peak Team").

use_sender_name.description: Whether to use `sender_name` on outgoing communications (e.g., true, false).

show_address.description: Whether the business address is shown on the client-facing site (e.g., true, false).

show_phone.description: Whether the business phone is shown on the client-facing site (e.g., true, false).

show_email.description: Whether the business email is shown on the client-facing site (e.g., true, false).

show_website.description: Whether the business website is shown on the client-facing site (e.g., true, false).

200.description: The updated business settings object. When `address` changed, `structured_address` reflects the newly geocoded value.

application/json.name: Summit Peak Climate Solutions
application/json.address: 233 S Wacker Dr, Chicago, IL 60606, USA

structured_address.formatted_address: 233 S Wacker Dr, Chicago, IL 60606, USA

application/json.invoice_terms: Payment of invoices is due by the due date specified, or may be subject to late payment fees or interest charges.
application/json.estimate_terms: The estimate covers listed services/items only, and is based on the information provided at the time. Changes or additions may increase costs. The estimate is valid only until the expiration date specified, unless updated otherwise.

401.description: The staff lacks settings access for this business.

403.description: The token is not authorized to act on this business — e.g. a Directory token sent without the `X-On-Behalf-Of` header, or a token that does not belong to the business or its owning directory.

422.description: Validation failed for one or more fields.
